
 Usage: houston api [OPTIONS] {method} {path}

 Make an authenticated REST call against a repro and print the response.

 Examples:
 houston api GET  /api/v1/me
 houston api POST /api/v1/users.update --pat -d '{"userId":"ID","data":{"name":"X"}}'
 houston api POST /api/v1/users.update --2fa -d '{"userId":"ID","data":{"name":"X"}}'

╭─ Arguments ──╮
 *    method      <str>  HTTP method, e.g. GET / POST [required]
 *    path        <str>  API path, e.g. /api/v1/users.update [required]
╰──╯
╭─ Options ──╮
 --name  -n      <str>
 --data  -d      <str>  JSON request body (for POST/PUT)
 --pat                  auth with a bypass-2FA Personal Access Token (like a customer script)
 --2fa                  add the admin password-2FA header (to pass 2FA-guarded endpoints)
 --help                 Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
